title: Wrong data types and safe conversions

videos.script: Every column so far has been text. That was deliberate. Text holds anything, so nothing was lost on the way in. {{text}} But text cannot be added, compared as a date, or trusted to be a year. At some point every column has to become what it really is. {{convert}} That step is where data disappears without a sound. Ask pandas to convert a column, tell it to ignore errors, and every value it cannot read becomes a blank. No warning. Just fewer numbers. {{silent}} So the rule for this lesson is simple. Every conversion counts what it failed to convert. If the count is not zero, the conversion stops and says which values. {{rule}} Then the decisions. A year written with two digits. A yes written ten different ways. A whole number with holes in it. {{decisions}} And at the end, a table whose types and checks refuse bad data at the door, so the next file cannot do quietly what this one did. {{end}}
